description: Rodoviária de Lisboa GTFS is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors S.A Rodoviária de Lisboa. Rodoviária de Lisboa GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) data regarding suburban buses in Lisbon district. Components: agency.txt: Baseline information about Metropolitano de Lisboa, including the agency's name, website URL, and timezone. routes.txt: Defines the transit routes. A route is a group of trips that are displayed to riders as a single service. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
